risks.name: Privileged access exceeds least privilege
risks.threat: Authenticated or compromised identities perform high-impact actions beyond approved authority.
risks.vulnerability: Broad, stale, inherited, or unevaluated permissions.
risks.consequence: Unauthorized access, destructive changes, fraud, disruption, or governance override.
risks.plan: Wire identity, authority, purpose, resource sensitivity, and least-privilege checks; review permissions; test allowed and denied paths.

risks.name: MFA bypass or unenforced privileged authentication
risks.threat: Credential theft, session compromise, or recovery-channel abuse.
risks.vulnerability: Privileged identities and MFA/recovery configuration are not fully verified.
risks.consequence: Account takeover and unauthorized control of systems, data, funds, code, or communications.
risks.plan: Inventory privileged identities, enforce MFA, harden recovery, expire exceptions, and verify monthly.

risks.name: Operating actions lack immutable evidence
risks.threat: Actions or release decisions occur without reliable proof or are altered without detection.
risks.vulnerability: Capture, append-only storage, hashing, retention, and reconciliation are not validated end to end.
risks.consequence: Unsupported claims, failed investigations, and inability to prove authorization.
risks.plan: Create canonical evidence events with SHA-256 and block release when evidence is missing.

risks.name: Assets or sensitive data remain unclassified
risks.threat: Sensitive or potentially regulated data is handled without appropriate safeguards.
risks.vulnerability: Inventory, ownership, sensitivity, retention, approved location, and disposal rules are incomplete.
risks.consequence: Disclosure, excessive retention, improper AI/vendor use, privacy harm, or contractual exposure.
risks.plan: Complete asset and data-flow inventories and assign owner, class, handling, access, retention, and disposal.

risks.name: Control effectiveness is claimed without testing
risks.threat: Controls or frameworks are described as effective before required proof exists.
risks.vulnerability: Lifecycle transitions and release language are not technically blocked.
risks.consequence: Misleading claims, failed diligence, contractual exposure, and damaged trust.
risks.plan: Enforce lifecycle order and prohibit effectiveness language without implementation, evidence, test, and reviewer approval.

risks.name: Incident escalation or containment fails
risks.threat: Security, privacy, availability, vendor, or integrity events are not detected or escalated promptly.
risks.vulnerability: Severity rules, contacts, authority, playbooks, and recovery validation are not tested.
risks.consequence: Expanded impact, evidence loss, outage, communication error, or repeat incidents.
risks.plan: Install severity and escalation logic, containment playbooks, evidence preservation, recovery validation, and simulations.

risks.name: Vendor access or data use lacks due diligence
controls: Vendor Due Diligence and Access Review
risks.threat: A vendor or sub-processor accesses systems or data without sufficient review.
risks.vulnerability: Vendor inventory, criticality, terms, sub-processors, access boundaries, and offboarding proof are incomplete.
risks.consequence: Third-party breach, privacy failure, disruption, lock-in, or unapproved data use.
risks.plan: Classify vendors, complete diligence, approve terms, restrict access, review critical vendors, and preserve offboarding evidence.

risks.name: Expired exceptions remain active
risks.threat: A temporary exception persists after approval expires.
risks.vulnerability: Ownership, expiry, alerts, reapproval, linked risk, and enforcement are not automated.
risks.consequence: Permanent bypass, accumulated exposure, unauthorized release, and weak risk acceptance evidence.
risks.plan: Require authority, compensating measures, expiry, monthly review, alerting, and RED enforcement on expiry.

risks.name: Backup or restore does not meet continuity needs
risks.threat: Critical data, configuration, code, or evidence becomes unavailable or corrupted.
risks.vulnerability: Recovery objectives, coverage, retention, restore procedures, and recoverability are unvalidated.
risks.consequence: Extended outage, permanent data loss, missed obligations, or unsafe reconstruction.
risks.plan: Define critical assets and recovery objectives, validate backup coverage, and perform representative restores.

risks.name: Framework applicability or compliance claims are overstated
risks.threat: Materials imply certification, attestation, HIPAA compliance, or effectiveness without the required basis.
risks.vulnerability: Scope, applicability, assessment status, evidence, reviewer approval, and claim language are not release-enforced.
risks.consequence: Customer deception, legal or contractual exposure, failed diligence, and reputational damage.
risks.plan: Maintain canonical framework states, classify claims, require reviewer approval, block prohibited language, and determine HIPAA applicability.
